document.title: Aspect Slicer Software Specification
document.purpose: Specify the Aspect Slicer application: a simple Tkinter-based tool for managing print designs, importing source images, defining exact aspect-ratio crop regions, and exporting PNG slices for Robert's print workflow.
author: Lion Kimbro
Wing-Cat (Chat-GPT)

project.name: aspect-slicer
project.title: Aspect Slicer
project.purpose: A simple Tkinter-based production tool for Robert to manage print designs, import source images, define exact-aspect-ratio crop rectangles, and export PNG slices for common print sizes.
project.description: Robert starts from sticker-like source art, typically a 2:3 image, and needs to produce cropped print images for 8.5x11, 11x17, and 13x19 print formats. The app stores designs, series, imported source images, crop coordinates, and output slices in a simple local folder structure.

v1: Main designs window with a single-select tree listing designs.
Design window for editing design metadata, importing a source image, defining crop rectangles, and exporting slices.
Dictionary-based data model serialized to JSON.
No M1 dependency, though data should be shaped in an M1-compatible style where reasonable.
No full series management window in v1.
Sound feedback is specified but not required for v1 implementation.

coding-style.top-level-state: plain dictionaries and module-level functions are acceptable

uuid-language.note: If older notes or spoken dictation say GUID, treat it silently as UUID.

normalization.description: When converting human text to identifiers, lowercase the text, replace runs of invalid characters with underscores, collapse repeated underscores, and strip leading/trailing underscores.

title-rules.description: Titles are for human expression and may contain almost any character. Titles do not need to be machine-safe.

tags.normalization: normalize each token using the identifier normalizer

8_5x11.note: 8.5x11 is internally represented as 17:22 to avoid fractional pixels.

supported-input-formats: webp if supported by the installed Pillow/Tkinter environment

hash.note: Hash the imported image file bytes.

canvas-display.note: For v1, always display the source image at height 632 regardless of original size. This may change in the future.

slice-output.pixel-dimensions: Use selected source-image pixel crop dimensions exactly.

required-fields.name: string identifier, blank until locked
required-fields.title: string
required-fields.source-file-path: string original external path or empty string
required-fields.image-file: managed imported image filename or empty string

new-series-defaults.name: normalized typed series name
new-series-defaults.title: human-readable title derived from typed input if needed

series.selection-rule: Designs store series-uuid. UI allows user to select or type series by name, and the app resolves that name to the series UUID.

tree..aspect-slicer/designs/<uuid>/: Folder for a single active design.
tree..aspect-slicer/designs/<uuid>/image.webp: Imported source image if WEBP supported.
tree..aspect-slicer/trash/: Trash area for deleted design folders.
tree..aspect-slicer/trash/<uuid>/design.json: Snapshot of design dictionary at deletion time.

on-design-create: Add design dictionary to core.json designs map.
on-delete-design: Write design dictionary to .aspect-slicer/designs/<uuid>/design.json or directly into trash destination as design.json.
If trash/<uuid>/ already exists, choose a non-conflicting trash folder name.
Remove design from core.json designs map.

master-window.title: Aspect Slicer

behavior: Initialize project folder through lionscliapp.
Load or create core.json.
Show all designs in single-select Tkinter tree.
Play startup sound if sound is implemented and enabled.

design-tree.type: Tkinter Treeview or project-standard Tkinter tree control

display-rules.name: If design name is blank, show <unnamed a8c3>, where a8c3 is the first four characters of the UUID.
display-rules.title: Show title as-is.
display-rules.series-name: Resolve series-uuid to series name. If no series, show blank.

create-new-design-button.label: Create New Design
behavior: Create new design dictionary.
Create folder structure for the design.
Add design to core data.
Save immediately.
Open design window.
Focus should begin in the large Title entry.

delete-design-button.label: Delete Design
behavior: Require selected design.
Ask for confirmation.
Move design folder to trash.
Write design.json snapshot into trashed folder.
Remove design from active core designs.
Save immediately.
Refresh design tree.
Play delete sound if implemented and enabled.

audio-checkbox.label: audio
behavior: When checked, event sounds are enabled.
When unchecked, event sounds are disabled.
Changing checkbox marks core dirty and should save.

close-behavior: Commit pending field values from open windows if practical.
Play shutdown sound if implemented and enabled.

layout.primary-orientation: left metadata/action panel and right crop canvas panel
layout.left-side: metadata, source image, import/open controls, slicing controls
layout.right-side: canvas image view and crop mode buttons

open-behavior: Play open-design sound if implemented and enabled.
Ensure design folder and slices folder exist.
If imported image exists, load it and display it scaled to height 632.
Draw crop rectangles according to current crop mode.

title-field.label: Design:
title-field.focus: For newly created designs, initial focus starts here.
behavior: User can type any human-readable title.
While name is not locked, changing title auto-populates or updates the proposed name field using identifier normalization.
Field changes mark dirty on focus-out or suitable field-change event.

name-field.label: Name:

behavior: Starts blank for new designs.
Auto-filled from normalized title while unlocked.
User may edit before locking.
Lock Name validates and normalizes the name.
Lock Name requires non-empty unique valid identifier.
After successful lock, set design.name-locked to true and save immediately.
Show locked name as text.
Do not show Entry.
Do not show Lock Name button.
Do not allow casual editing.

validation: Must be unique among all design names.

until-name-locked: Disable View Slices unless the design somehow already has slices.
Show gentle message such as: Choose and lock a design name before importing an image.

tags-field.label: Tags:
behavior: Normalize tokens on focus-out.
Store as list of identifier strings.
Mark dirty on change.

series-field.label: Series:
behavior: List known series names.
Allow blank/no-series selection.
Allow user to type a new series name.
Resolve existing series name to series UUID.
If typed series name is not recognized, enable or visually highlight Create Series button.
When Create Series is clicked, create new series dictionary and set design.series-uuid to that new UUID.

create-series-button.label: Create Series
create-series-button.enabled-when: Typed normalized series name is non-empty and does not match existing series.
behavior: Create series with generated UUID.
Set series.name to normalized typed name.
Set series.title to human-readable typed text if available.
Set created-date to today.
Add to core.series.
Set current design.series-uuid to new series UUID.
Save immediately.

source-file-path.label: Source Image:
source-file-path.description: Original external source path selected by Browse.

browse-button.label: Browse
behavior: Open file picker.
User selects image file.
Immediately import the selected image.
Copy file into .aspect-slicer/designs/<uuid>/ as image.jpeg, image.png, or image.webp depending on source format.
Set design.source-file-path to original external path.
Set design.image-file to managed image filename.
Calculate SHA256 hash of imported image bytes.
Store image width and height.
Replace old imported image if one exists.
Clear existing crop rectangles.
Create centered maximum default crops for supported aspect ratios.
Display imported image on canvas at height 632.
Save immediately.

containing-button.label: Containing
behavior: Open containing folder of original source image using Windows default file explorer behavior.

open-button.label: Open
behavior: Open original source image file using Windows default application behavior.

slice.label: Slice
slice.enabled-when: design.name-locked is true and imported image exists and at least one crop rectangle exists
behavior: For each crop rectangle that exists, crop from imported source image using Pillow.
Save output PNG into .aspect-slicer/designs/<uuid>/slices/.
Use exact filenames: <design-name>_8_5x11.png, <design-name>_11x17.png, <design-name>_13x19.png.
Only output slices for crop rectangles that exist.
Do not require all three crop rectangles.
Use source image pixel coordinates exactly.
Ignore DPI.
Save immediately after successful slicing.
Refresh View Slices button enabled state.

view-slices.label: View Slices
view-slices.enabled-when: slices folder contains at least one file
behavior: Open .aspect-slicer/designs/<uuid>/slices/ in Windows file explorer.
view-slices.note: The slices folder itself is created when the design is created, but this button should not light up until the folder has at least one file.

canvas.role: Display imported image and crop rectangles.

image-display.note: Keep a Python reference to PhotoImage so Tkinter does not garbage collect it.

crop-rectangle-items.description: Rectangles are named/tagged canvas items representing crop regions.
coordinate-mapping: Stored crop coordinates are source image pixels.
Canvas rectangles are display-scaled versions of stored source coordinates.
On mouse input, convert canvas coordinates back to source image coordinates.

all-mode: Do not allow drawing new crop in All mode unless explicitly changed later.
single-crop-mode: Show and edit only selected crop rectangle.
Mouse down starts defining crop rectangle from top-left point.
On mouse release, compute valid aspect-ratio-correct rectangle in source pixels.
Play crop-complete sound if implemented and enabled.
aspect-ratio-rule: The displayed rectangle must be exactly aspect-ratio correct.
The final source-pixel rectangle must have integer width and height matching the selected ratio.
For 11x17, width = 11 * n and height = 17 * n.
For 13x19, width = 13 * n and height = 19 * n.
For 8.5x11, width = 17 * n and height = 22 * n.
While dragging, choose the minimal valid rectangle that contains the current mouse position.
bounds-rule: Crop rectangle must stay within source image bounds.
If drag would exceed image bounds, clamp to maximum valid rectangle within image.
If drag is too small to create at least n=1, do not commit or commit the smallest valid rectangle only if practical.

close-behavior: Play window-close sound if implemented and enabled.

default-centered-maximum-crop.description: When an image is imported, compute default centered maximum crop rectangles for all three aspect ratios.
rule: Find the largest rectangle of the requested aspect ratio that fits inside the image.
Use integer multiples of the aspect ratio.
Center the rectangle in the source image.
Store as [x0, y0, x1, y1] with x1/y1 exclusive.

drag-to-crop.description: During crop dragging, choose the smallest valid aspect-ratio rectangle from the mouse-down point that contains the current mouse position.
rule: Assume anchor is the top-left point.
Compute required width and height to contain the current mouse position.
Find n such that ratio_width*n >= required_width and ratio_height*n >= required_height.
Clamp to image bounds if necessary.
Store final rectangle on mouse release.

slicing.description: Slice selected crops from imported source image.
behavior: Open managed imported image file from design folder.
For each non-null crop rectangle, call image.crop((x0, y0, x1, y1)).
Save each output as PNG in slices folder.
Use exact output filename convention.

save-behavior.style: autosave with dirty flag, no explicit Save button

dirty-flag.description: Any meaningful unsaved change marks the app dirty.
dirty-flag.visual-indicator: red Unsaved indicator in status bar
dirty-flag.saved-indicator: green Saved indicator in status bar

behavior: Every 5 seconds, if dirty, write core.json.
Use atomic write pattern: write core.json.tmp then replace core.json using os.replace.
After successful save, clear dirty flag and update indicator.

immediate-save-events: Complete crop rectangle on mouse release
notes: During live crop dragging, do not mark dirty until the rectangle is fully specified on mouse release.
Design field edits may mark dirty on focus-out or field-change depending on implementation simplicity.

sounds-feedback.implementation-status: specified but not required for v1

implementation-approach.reason: Simple Windows-first audible feedback without requiring bundled sound files.

program-start.description: Announces that the program has started.

program-close.description: Signs off when the application closes.

open-design.description: Played when a design window opens.

crop-start.description: Played when user starts specifying a crop region.

crop-complete.description: Played when crop region is completed and accepted.

delete-design.description: Played when a design is deleted/moved to trash.
delete-design.note: winsound.Beep cannot make true white noise. This descending soft scrub is a placeholder.

window-close.description: Played when a design window closes.

process-notes: Sounds should confirm state transitions, not distract.
Audio checkbox in master window disables all sounds.
Sound behavior should be centralized in one or two helper functions.
If winsound is unavailable, sound helpers should silently do nothing.
For v1, it is acceptable to specify this and leave implementation out.

example-inspired-shape.description: Play a one-shot event pattern if audio is enabled.
example-inspired-shape.return-value: For simple v1 or v1.1, return None or boolean success. Interruptible audio is not required.

name-locking.reason: The design name determines output filenames. It should not casually change after work begins.
rules: New designs start with blank name and name-locked false.
Title editing proposes a normalized name.
Before image import or crop work, name must be locked.
After locking, name appears as a Label, not an Entry.
No Lock Name button appears once locked.

delete-safety: Move design folder to trash instead of deleting permanently.
Write design.json snapshot of design metadata in trash folder.
slice-safety: Do not require all three crop rectangles.
Do not silently invent crops at slice time except default crops created at image import.
image-replacement: If Browse imports a new image over an existing one, replace the managed image.
Compute new centered maximum default crops.

implementation-order: Create project skeleton and command entry point aspect-slicer.
Use lionscliapp to establish .aspect-slicer project folder.
Implement core.json load/create/save with atomic save.
Implement dictionary constructors for new design and new series.
Implement master designs window with tree, create, delete, audio checkbox, and status indicator.
Implement title-to-name normalization while name is unlocked.
Implement Browse/import image using Pillow and shutil.
Implement canvas image display scaled to height 632.
Implement default centered maximum crop calculation.
Implement crop mode buttons and rectangle drawing.
Implement Slice with Pillow crop and PNG output.
Optionally implement sound helper and event calls after v1 basics work.
testing-notes: Test creation of .aspect-slicer folder from empty state.
Test core.json creation from empty state.
Test creating a design creates design folder and slices folder.
Test title normalization: Cool Print 7 becomes cool_print_7.
Test Lock Name rejects blank names.
Test Lock Name rejects duplicate names.
Test image import preserves extension and computes hash.
Test image replacement clears old crop rectangles and creates new default crops.
Test crop rectangle math for 17:22, 11:17, and 13:19.
Test View Slices enabled only after at least one output exists.
Test delete moves folder to trash and writes design.json.
Test autosave writes core.json and clears dirty flag.
robert-workflow-principles: Make the natural human action work.
Do not require Robert to understand naming conventions.
Lock machine names before file-producing work begins.
Keep actions tactile, obvious, and forgiving.
Use filesystem trash instead of destructive deletes.

open-questions-left: Exact visual styling of crop rectangles is not specified.
Exact colors for crop rectangles are not specified.
Whether crop rectangles should have draggable adjustment handles is not part of v1.
Whether sound is implemented in v1 or v1.1 is left to implementation priority.
Whether WEBP should be accepted depends on local Pillow/Tkinter support.
